2. No one appears on behalf of the applicants to press this application U/s 482 Cr.P.C. even in the revised list.

3. Heard Sri Triveni Saran Rai, learned counsel for the State of U.P. and perused the records.
4.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants Mahesh Chand Jindal,
Smt. Archana Devi and Manoj Tayal with the following prayers:

sentences.text:
1 "It is therefore, most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to allow the instant application under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. and set- aside /
quash the charge-sheet dated 22.02.2014 submitted in Case Crime No. 70 of 2013,
under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC & 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act Police Station Mahila Thana, Noida District: Gautam Buddh Nagar as well as entire proceedings of Case No. 220 of 2014 arising out of the said charge-sheet under Sections 498A, 323,
504, 506 IPC & 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act Police Station Mahila Thana, Noida District: Gautam Buddh Nagar, pending in the court of learned the Judicial Magistrate, Gautam Budh Nagar.

It is further prayed this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to stay the further proceedings of Case No. 220 of 2014 arising out of Case Crime No. 70 of 2013, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC & 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act Police Station:
Mahila Thana, Noida District: Gautam Buddh Nagar pending in the court of learned Judicial Magistrate, Gautam Budh Nagar, and/or be pleased to pass such other and further order(s) which this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case."
5.

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The matter is of the year 2013.
There are chances of the matter being rendered infructuous by efflux of time.
6. The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is dismissed as infructuous.
7. Interim order, if any, stands vacated.

8. Office to communicate this order to the trial court concerned within two weeks.
9.
If cause survives, the applicants will have liberty to file an appropriate application for reviving the matter.
